svg.title: Two turns of an Archimedean spiral with shaded areas
svg.desc: The spiral r equals a theta over two turns, with the first-turn region shaded teal and the second-turn shell shaded orange, the circles of radius d and 2d shown dashed.
svg.text: Two turns of the Archimedean spiral
r = aθ. The first turn encloses A₁ = πd²/3; the shell added by the second turn has area 6A₁.
